Interface BundleManager

    • addBundleToHolder

      void addBundleToHolder(long bundleId, BundleHolder bundleHolder) throws BundleManagerException

      Add a bundle to a bundle holder (e.g. a Resource Context).

      This method should ensure the unicity of the association between a bundle and its holder. A bundle can only be associated to a single holder. This method is thread safe.

      Parameters:
      bundleId - bundle identifier
      bundleHolder - bundle holder
      Throws:
      BundleManagerException - if the bundle is associated to another bundle holder.

    • removeBundleFromHolder

      void removeBundleFromHolder(long bundleId, BundleHolder bundleHolder) throws BundleManagerException

      Remove a bundle from a bundle holder.

      This method is thread safe

      Parameters:
      bundleId - bundle identifier
      bundleHolder - bundle holder
      Throws:
      BundleManagerException - if the bundle is not currently associated with the specified bundle holder.
